description: Defines the QuicSpdyClientStream class, which manages SPDY request/response streams over QUIC in the Chromium project. It handles sending requests, receiving headers and data, and stream state management.

classes.name: quic::QuicSpdyClientStream
classes.description: Manages SPDY request and response over QUIC, including headers, body, and stream state.

methods.name: QuicSpdyClientStream
methods.description: Constructs a new SPDY client stream with stream ID and session.

methods.name: OnInitialHeadersComplete
methods.description: Handles completion of initial headers reception.

methods.name: OnBodyAvailable
methods.description: Called when body data is available.

methods.name: SendRequest
methods.description: Serializes headers and body, sends request, returns bytes sent.

methods.name: header_bytes_read
methods.description: Returns number of header bytes read.

methods.name: header_bytes_written
methods.description: Returns number of header bytes written.

methods.name: CopyAndValidateHeaders
methods.description: Copies and validates headers, extracts content length.

methods.name: ParseAndValidateStatusCode
methods.description: Parses and validates response status code.
